entities.summary: Miskito Kingdom, a political institution in Nicaragua during Spanish Conquest and Colonial Nicaragua (1630–1860). Grew from León–Granada Rivalry and Conquest and Indigenous Slave Trade. Led to the emergence of Miskito Kingdom and British Alliance.
